modules.name: img_bayer_window_frontend_draft
limitations: Raw stream to cropped 3x3-window to bilinear RGB888; no border padding
Output dimensions are source width-2 and height-2
RAW_BITS supports 8,10,12; II is at least two enabled cycles
Small-frame completion/backpressure and BRAM board checks passed; arbitrary parameter boundaries and full-video throughput unverified

scoped_board_verification.scope: Finite valid-crop RAW->two synchronous lines->Bayer RGB chain; max11x8/MAX_WIDTH11. Not default1920 width, border padding or full-video signoff. Candidate frontend adds observational ports only; window and Bayer kernel byte-identical to production.

modules.name: img_color_pipeline_auto
limitations: RGB888 or optional BT.601 full-range YCbCr444
Global color commit requires quiescent and drained input, including AWB buffers
Automatic gains are independently committed at a future SOF
No board integration or measured resource/timing fit

latency_update_20261017.notes: The diagnostic candidate top aligns its parallel Gamma output with three elastic test-only stages; these stages are not part of the production Gamma module or serial color pipeline.
